name: io.github.tonyyang0504/alimama-mcp
description: 阿里妈妈 Alimama (ads): me, list_campaigns, get_report, update_budget, pause_resume. Every tool maps to

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_ALIMAMA_APP_KEY
environmentVariables.description: AppKey of a 淘宝开放平台 application granted the 阿里妈妈 万相台无界 API permission (https://open.taobao.com).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_ALIMAMA_APP_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: AppSecret of that application; never sent, used for the MD5 request signature.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_ALIMAMA_SESSION
environmentVariables.description: Seller session key (授权信息 'session') issued when the merchant authorised the app through the TOP OAuth flow (https://open.taobao.com/doc.htm?docId=101617&docType=1: session is required for APIs marked 需要授权); renew it by re-authorising when it expires.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_ALIMAMA_BIZ_CODE
environmentVariables.description: 万相台无界 scene code (api业务线编码) sent in top_service_context, e.g. onebpDisplay (人群推广), onebpSearch (关键词推广) or onebpSite (全站推广); taobao.universalbp.new.account.get.can.use.bizcode lists the codes the account may use.
